# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/license_inventory.py from docs/compliance/license_inventory.json. Do not edit. -->

The MIT `LICENSE` of this repository covers the code written here. It does not cover
the packages below, the third-party data in the fixtures, or anything a provider
owns. Each keeps the terms it was published under.

This list is generated, not a legal conclusion. A licence is `recorded` when its
declared text matches a plainly permissive identifier; anything else is `needs
review` and is left to the maintainer. Until that review is done, nothing here says
every dependency is clear.

## Bundled assets

| Asset | Kind | In wheel | Origin | Terms | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| terminal-captures (`docs/assets/terminal/*`) | image (GIF) | no | recorded from this project's own CLI and examples (docs/terminal-captures.md) | made in this repository; MIT | recorded |
| dataset-metadata-and-status (`src/kpubdata/dataset_metadata.json`, `src/kpubdata/dataset_status.json`) | data file | yes | written in this repository (verification levels and dates) | made in this repository; MIT | recorded |
| dataset-specs (`src/kpubdata/specs/*`) | data file (YAML specs) | yes | written in this repository from each provider's public usage guide | structure written here; names, parameter descriptions and per-dataset terms declared in the spec's license field follow the provider (docs/policy/terms-matrix.md) | needs review |
| provider-catalogues (`src/kpubdata/providers/*/catalogue.json`) | data file (dataset catalogues) | yes | dataset names and identifiers taken from each provider's public listing | facts about third-party datasets; provider terms are not recorded per entry | needs review |
| recorded-fixtures (`tests/fixtures/*`) | recorded API responses | no | recorded from live provider APIs by the recording workflow | third-party data under each provider's own terms (for example KOGL, the Korean Open Government License marks, set per service on data.go.kr); NOT relicensed as MIT, see docs/policy/terms-matrix.md | needs review |

The wheel packs `src/kpubdata` only. The source distribution has no exclusion rule,
so it also carries the fixtures and docs above; their terms apply there too.
Fonts and icons: none are tracked in this repository (checked by the same script).
